QuestInfo.name: The Stolen Seal Stone
QuestInfo.0: Ask Lilin what she knows about the Seal Stone of Ellin Forest.
QuestInfo.2: You spokes with Neinheart in Ereve.

0.0: I don't really know much. Aran would be able to fill you in, but he's off on an adventure right now.
0.1: He said he remembered protecting the key to Ellin Forest a long time ago with Athena Pierce. He called it a Seal Stone, but he couldn't remember what it actually was.
0.2: All I know for sure is that the Black Wings are involved and the Seal Stone has been stolen. I don't know what they're planning on doing to Ellin Forest, but it can't be good.

yes.0: And would you tell Neinheart that I'm doing okay? He doesn't have to worry so much.

no.0: Are you sightseeing in Rien? It doesn't seem like the best use of your time.

yes.0: Neither Aran nor Lilin seem to have any more information. This is worrisome.

npc.0: Say hi to Neinheart for me.
